title: Maximum of Minimums for Every Window Size
statement:
Given an array arr[] of size n, for every window size i from 1 to n, find the maximum of the minimum of all contiguous subarrays of size i.

Return an array of size n where the i-th element contains the maximum of minimums for window size i + 1.

**Example 1:**

```
Input: arr = [10, 20, 30, 50, 10, 70, 30]
Output: [70, 30, 20, 10, 10, 10, 10]
Explanation:
- Window size 1: max of [10, 20, 30, 50, 10, 70, 30] → 70
- Window size 2: max of [10,20], [20,30], ..., [70,30] → max of all mins → 30
- ... and so on.
```

**Example 2:**

```
Input: arr = [6, 3, 5, 1, 12]
Output: [12, 3, 3, 1, 1]
```
facts: In mathematical morphology and fuzzy signal processing, this operation summarizes the strongest contiguous region whose weakest value is as large as possible.
It models bottleneck planning: selecting a consecutive time period or route segment where the least-capable point is maximized.
